newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates rise.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates rise.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound rose in the private-sector market on Sunday to between 8-1/4 and nine percent from eight and 8-1/4 percent on Thursday, bankers said.
The market started short but turned liquid, they added.
One-week rates also rose to a range of 8-1/2 and 9-3/8 percent from between 8-1/4 and 9-1/2 percent, the bankers said.
Some bankers quoted the lending rate at public-sector banks at around 10 percent compared to their long-standing lending rate of 10-1/2 percent.
